name: Haiku macro/sector rotation
strategy: Rate hike acceleration play: maximize energy and financial tailwinds while hedging duration risk with defensive healthcare and crypto upside.
reassessment_note: FOMC is 91% priced to hike 25bp tomorrow, confirming macro regime shift. Current book (down 1.8% vs SPY +1.35%) is misaligned: overweight rate-sensitive small-cap (IWM -2.92%, 19% of book) and growth tech (QQQ -1.44%, 9% of book), underweight rate winners. Energy sector leads Q3 up 22% on sustained $90/bbl oil forecast (Iran geopolitical support). XLE outperforms SPY by 600bps. Financials are net-interest-margin beneficiaries from higher rates. Exiting small-cap/growth/gold to rotate into rate-hike winner (XLE 22%), financial carry (XLF 20%), defensive healthcare (XLV 20%), and risk-on clarity play (BTC 12%). Increasing cash buffer 10%→26% for post-FOMC volatility management.

positions.thesis: Energy sector is the structural winner in a rate-hike regime. XLE up 21.6% YTD, +9% last 30 days on sustained geopolitical premium (Iran tensions). Oil forecasted $90/bbl average H2 2026. Leading sector position (Exxon+Chevron 42.5% of fund) have demonstrated earnings resilience. As rates rise, energy cash flows become more valuable in relative valuation terms. Maximum weight position to capture momentum and sector leadership.

Financial sector is direct rate-hike beneficiary through net-interest-margin expansion. Higher rates (3.75%-4.00% forecast) increase lending spreads while funding costs remain anchored. Banks have demonstrated resilience despite rate volatility. Higher rates also support insurance investment yields. Large-cap financial quality positioning for carry trade and dividend support in equity rotation away from duration-sensitive growth.

Healthcare provides defensive shelter and earnings turnaround narrative independent of rate environment. Sector offers orthogonal returns to rates and energy. Maintains exposure to secular growth (aging demographics, AI-driven biotech) while hedging against post-hike volatility in risk assets. Dividend yield (2-3%) provides income support. Essential portfolio ballast maintaining equity exposure while rotating out of rate-sensitive names.

Bitcoin is risk-on proxy benefiting from macro clarity post-FOMC. Current up 22.5% YTD reflects macro regime change acceptance. With Fed hike now confirmed expected, cryptocurrency markets reduce uncertainty premium. BTC benefits from 'Fed pivot becomes discountable' narrative as markets can now price forward. Positioned for post-FOMC risk-on squeeze as rate-path clarity improves asset pricing. 12% allocation captures upside while 26% cash prevents over-leverage.
